title: Pair-midpoint drift and apparatus/projection diagnostics
displayed_quantities: pair-distance residual relative to the frozen radial law
claim_limits: Pair-midpoint motion is an apparatus/projection nuisance diagnostic and is not absorbed into tracker error.
The expected radial law is a physics-constrained consistency reference, not image-by-image absolute position ground truth.
Only valid pair measurements are plotted; missing pair positions are not interpolated or connected.
